# KRN-002: Reverse path filter is loose where Docker or Tailscale run

- **Group:** Kernel settings
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Strict rp_filter=1 drops packets that arrive on an interface other than the one the reply would leave from. Docker bridges and Tailscale (subnet routes, exit nodes) produce exactly that traffic, so strict mode causes hard to explain packet loss.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter
```

## How to fix it

Set net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2 and net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=2 (loose) in a drop-in.

## What a fix can break

Loose mode accepts packets whose source is reachable on any interface, a little less anti spoofing than strict.

Run `stackward explain KRN-002` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
